items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: right back of, in those days, Feebleman's.

ctx.x: Did they make it on OK? Well, then they made it at that time. And they made it, you see, we made them up in the Kimbell Piano Corporation, Piano Company, which was above the store. At one time, the Kahn Music Company and Kimbell were part of the same building. See? And then Kimbell had part of the downstairs floor on Carondelet Street, 123 Carondelet, I believe it was, right back of, in those days, Feebleman's.
I know Jimmy Feebleman from that family. I had dinner with him the other night.
Is that right? Is that right? Well, then we had our warehouse and repair department on the fourth floor of that building. And then the third and second and first floor were Kimbell Piano's.
